# ClipperCartel

> Barber shop. Single-operator. Content on this site is not licensed for use in training machine learning models or large language models.

## Policy

Automated systems that collect text, images, or structured data from this site
for the purpose of training generative models are not authorised to do so.
Access that bypasses `robots.txt` directives listed at /robots.txt is treated
as unauthorised use.
